purpose: Frozen IME evidence boundary. Defines which IME scenarios must be automated and which require signed manual evidence before IME acceptance can be claimed. Approved at R0.

automated.description: Scenarios covered by deterministic automated tests (Core command-level and unit) that do not depend on a real OS IME composition session.
scenarios: grapheme/UTF-16 offset mapping for CJK, emoji, surrogate pairs, combining marks
compositionstart/update/end transaction grouping into a single Core History group
protected-range marker suspension near active composition
deferred conflicting projection until composition end
exact source projection fallback when composition intersects a folded marker

signedManual.description: Scenarios that require a human-operated real OS IME on the target platform, captured as evidence.json with operator signature and platform environment.
scenarios: macOS: Chinese pinyin continuous input on canonical corpus (>= 1000 events) with zero lost/duplicated/reordered characters
Windows: system IME (Chinese/Japanese) with the same corpus
Korean, emoji, combining mark, RTL core scenarios repeated on at least one platform
single-Undo of a complete composition with no residual pinyin or markers

boundary: CI cannot provide a stable automated Chinese IME, so IME acceptance for a platform is only claimable via signedManual evidence from that platform. Automated scenarios gate implementation readiness but never substitute for signed manual evidence.
